what: A shares the world on 127.0.0.1:8802 while on the continent: the attached world leaves the continent; the door shows continent-world-attached and openMyDoor() is refused

actions.eval: (async () => { const t0 = Date.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const t = l ? l.innerText : ''; if (/Online/.test(t) && /Invites/.test(t)) return { ms: Date.now() - t0 }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'timeout' })()
(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); return l ? l.innerText.slice(0, 3500) : 'no door layer' })()

(async () => { const N = await import('/net/continent.ts'); const c = N.getActiveContinent(); return JSON.stringify({ active: c ? c.code : null, hud: (document.body.innerText.match(/CONTINENT[^\n]*/g) ?? []) }) })()
